svg.title: Your Foundry agent in Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
svg.desc: Conversation traffic goes from Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot through Microsoft-managed channel infrastructure to the public IP-filtered Foundry Activity endpoint and hosted agent with no separate Azure Bot Service resource. Publication setup runs from a private-network workstation over Private Link to the Foundry project API.

g.text: Your Foundry agent in Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
Foundry registers the channel directly with no separate Azure Bot Service resource.
Shared RBAC or Tenant channel auth
No Azure Bot Service resource deployed
Publication setup and later changes (not conversation traffic)
The workstation calls the Foundry project API over Private Link. Channel registration creates no Azure Bot Service resource.
